claim: The old sageAssistant stack has several operational gotchas: sage-backend's /app/app is a live RW bind mount of /home/tlemmons/sageAssistant/sageUI/backend/app (deploy = edit host file + docker restart, with a 30-60s embedding-warmup startup), /voice/voice-chat with skip_tts=true returns HTTP 200 with an empty body and puts the transcription/answer in X-Transcribed-Text/X-Response-Text headers, GPT-4o escalation is phrase-based via ESCALATION_PHRASES in voice_routes.py (no numeric ESCALATION_THRESHOLD exists), sage-ollama is pinned to GPU 1 with OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=10m so idle queries pay a multi-second model reload, and a pre-existing datetime-JSON-serialization bug in app.semantic_fastpath means learned patterns never persist across restarts.
trigger: when /voice/voice-chat with skip_tts=true returns HTTP 200 with an empty response body
before health-checking sage-backend within the first minute after docker restart sage-backend
when 'Failed to persist patterns: Object of type datetime is not JSON serializable' appears in sage-backend startup logs
